"""Helper utilities."""

def running_mean(xs):
    """Return a list where the i-th element is the mean of xs[0..i]."""
    means = []
    current_sum = 0.0
    for i, x in enumerate(xs, 1):
        current_sum += x
        means.append(current_sum / i)
    return means

# CONSTRAINT: results are always floats, even for integer input.
